description: Builds or changes a FiveM resource with the RPScripts AI generator (QBCore, Qbox, ESX or standalone): the agent writes Lua/NUI files, checks them (syntax, manifest, framework API) and repairs problems. Uses the signed-in customer's AI credits (typically about 0.2 per script, at most 30 per day through MCP). Spending requires confirm_credit_use: true, which you may only set after the user explicitly agreed to spend credits. Without a prompt, returns the status and files of an existing project. Long runs continue in the background: call again with the project_id and no prompt to collect the result.

confirm_credit_use.description: true only after the user explicitly approved spending AI credits

locale.description: Language of names, descriptions and URLs (en, de, fr, pt, es)

max_credits.description: Upper limit of credits this run may use (default 2)

project_id.description: Continue an existing project instead of creating one

name: generate_script
title: Generate a FiveM script (RPScripts AI)
